local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local period=0;local elapsed=0;local path=nil;local index=2;local done=false
local last=nil;local stalled=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died inside The Blood Feast')
 local health=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 assert(health>35,'Road exploration needs earned healing before further travel')
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;period=period+dt;if elapsed<2 or period<.2 then return end;period=0
 if not path then
  local status,points=nearby.findPath(self.position,util.vector3(-1312,0,0),{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),includeFlags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.OpenDoor+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.UsePathgrid,destinationTolerance=128}})
  if status~=nearby.FIND_PATH_STATUS.Success or #points<3 then print('BloodFeast waiting path status='..tostring(status));return end
  path=points
  print('BloodFeast path selected status='..tostring(status)..' count='..#path)
  for i,p in ipairs(path) do print('BloodFeast path '..i..' '..tostring(p)) end
 end
 while index<=#path and (path[index]-self.position):length()<(index==#path and 40 or 90) do index=index+1 end
 if index>#path then
  assert((self.position-util.vector3(-1312,0,-240)):length()<160,'Actual Rending Halls doorway not reached')
  local ray=nearby.castRay(util.vector3(-475,-760,-200),util.vector3(-475,-450,-200),{{collisionType=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap}})
  assert(not ray.hit or not ray.hitObject or ray.hitObject.id~='0x10c48e4','Animated Sigil base still blocks the original floor lane')
  print('BloodFeast leg complete position='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..health)
  print('BloodFeast choice=done');return
 end
 local target=path[index]+util.vector3(0,0,65)
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target)
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('BloodFeast aim x=%d y=%d index=%d distance=%.2f health=%.3f position=%s',math.max(-80,math.min(80,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-40,math.min(40,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),index,(path[index]-self.position):length(),health,tostring(self.position)))
 print('BloodFeast choice='..(math.abs(ax)<.12 and 'move' or 'turn'))
end}}}}
